newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi Aramco increases bunker fuel prices.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Aramco increases bunker fuel prices.

text.p: Saudi Aramco has increased A-888 bunker diesel from Ras Tanura and Dammam by $7 a tonne to $201 a tonne with effect July 31, the company said on Wednesday.
A-960 bunker fuel from the two Gulf ports is $2 a tonne higher at $103 a tonne ($15.81 a barrel) and $4 a tonne higher at $101 ($15.50 a barrel) a tonne from the Red Sea ports of Jeddah and Yanbu.
A-888 from the Red Sea is up $6 to $189 a tonne.
